name: Bulgarian split squat
notes: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, one leg at a time. Bodyweight or loaded; record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of the rear foot on it, with the front foot flat and the trunk braced.
guide.execution: Lower until the front thigh is near parallel and the rear knee is close to the floor, then drive up through the front foot.
guide.cues: Stay tall. Keep the weight through the front heel and midfoot. Control the descent.
guide.mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench; front knee collapsing inward; pushing off the rear foot; cutting the depth short.
